scope: Actual built-in generation. Geometry not accepted yet; A/C still have visibly incorrect miniature proportions. Original board bytes retained.

candidates.prompt:
Create a visual-direction preview BOARD, not a final presentation slide, for the fictional Japanese research-proposal manuscript 雨の図書室. The concept is untested: a small rain shelter with a roof receiving raindrops, a seat for listening, and a shelf for observation notes. No real building, performance results, institutions, authors, dates, engineering dimensions, budget or fabricated citations. This is a repair of a previous board whose frames were too tall.
Critical geometry: landscape canvas, exactly SIX separate miniature SLIDES in a two-row by three-column grid. Each miniature is a strictly horizontal true16:9 rectangle, all identical size; clearly bounded complete thin rectangular frames with square corners. Render each miniature as if480wide×270high. Never crop, stretch or rotate the frames, no vertical cards, no square miniatures. Put header above grid and specification band below. Shrink header/footer rather than changing the16:9 frames. The six frames must be visibly much wider than tall.
Header exact: 雨の図書室 / 架空の空間デザイン研究提案. Variant title below.
Six slide miniatures, different functional compositions:
1 cover with project title 雨の図書室 and one small shelter in rain.
2 INDEX: 提案と検証の4部構成 with four clearly typeset entries 視点03–04 / 空間05–06 / 体験07–08 / 検証09–10. Use an editorial index, no repeated shelter landscape.
3 dark SECTION DIVIDER: 空間 / 一つの庇に、三つの役割。 Strong roof-line motif.
4 CONTENT: 庇・席・棚の役割. An isolated orthographic CUTAWAY SECTION, three precise leader lines labeling 雨粒を受ける庇 / 音を聞く席 / 記録を置く棚. Qualifier 概念図・寸法未設定. No bridge/city scenery. Show roof above seat and shelf, understandable geometry.
5 CONTENT: 検証の計画 with three clear stages 試作する → 観察する → 見直す and qualifier 実施前. Show an actual model sketch, observation notes, and revision sheet, no fake chart.
6 STANDALONE CLOSING: あなたの街なら、どこに置く？ / 質疑・対話. Small shelter silhouette with open space.
Use correct concise Japanese only; do not add filler body paragraphs or invented facts. No watermark. Keep all labels legible, no labels across illustrations. Bottom band exact headings 色 / 書体 / 図 / 余白 / 用途, with brief variant specifications. This board demonstrates the whole page system and evidence carriers, not six decorative covers.
Variant title exact: A 白地・紺・断面図.
Off-white paper #F5F2E9, dark indigo #14283D, restrained blue-gray #879DA9. Japanese Mincho-style editorial headings, clean sans labels. Fine precise architectural ink linework. Large asymmetrical space. Roof horizontal rule as common motif. Dividers dark indigo. No rounded dashboard cards, no photoreal building claims. Bottom concise specs: 紙白・深紺 / 明朝とゴシック / 断面と引出線 / 非対称 / 研究構想の共有.
